“My baby started rejecting every meal…” 🥺

One day they love a food.
The next day they won’t even look at it.

If you’re going through a food rejection phase, you’re not alone 💛

This is one of the most common feeding challenges parents face, and it can leave you constantly wondering:
💭 What should I offer next?
💭 Is my child getting enough nutrition?
💭 Am I doing something wrong?

That’s exactly why we created Happy Eaters ✨

With age-wise meal plans, 2000+ recipes, portion guidance, and expert-backed feeding support, we’re here to make mealtimes a little less stressful and a lot more enjoyable.

Because every rejected meal doesn’t mean you’re failing as a parent 🤍

Comment “APP” and we’ll DM you the link 📲

Introducing solids shouldn’t feel like guesswork – yet so many parents are left piecing together advice from social media and Google.

Join my free workshop and let me, Edwena Kennedy (Pediatric Dietitian with 15+ years of experience) and founder of My Little Eater, guide you step-by-step through your baby’s first week of solids and beyond.

You’ll finish with the confidence to:

✅ Safely serve both finger foods and purees
✅ Handle gagging and avoid choking risks
✅ Balance meal and milk schedules
✅ Know what foods to serve to provide the best nutrition
✅ Avoid the most common mistakes that cause stress and picky eating down the road

Plus: You’ll receive a FREE 5-day meal plan so you know exactly what to serve each day of your baby’s first week – dietitian created and feeding therapist approved!

And at the very end, I’ll share an exclusive attendee-only discount on the full course so you can keep going with confidence.

No judgment. No complicated rules. Just a proven plan from someone who’s helped tens of thousands of families.

Grab your free seat today --> https://mylittleeater.com/workshop-hm
